steps.html:
Проверяйте, поспевает ли собеседник. В записи говорящий добавляет Got that? и OK? после сложных шагов, а слушатель спрашивает How do you do that? и What next?

Если слушатель что-то упустил, он может попросить повторить только одну часть: Can you say the part about the glue again?

steps.title: Сначала проговорите аргумент.
items: Честно ли выставлять новичка после четырёх недель против профессионалов?
Скажите позицию, затем одну причину, затем один пример. Три предложения вслух.

steps.title: Should beginners compete against professionals?
steps.html:
Читайте как автор: замечайте, как построен аргумент.

Образец

I believe that putting a four-week beginner into a contest against professionals is good television but poor training. One reason is that the beginner learns the wrong lesson. In four weeks you can teach someone a technique — how to hold a knife, how to flip a pancake, how to deal with a hot pan — but you cannot teach them what to do when the technique fails. For example, Ed was able to produce a professional dish under studio conditions, and he was still shocked, months later, to discover how much of the job was managing people rather than cooking.

A second reason is what it says to the professionals. They have spent years working to tight deadlines for ordinary money, and the programme suggests that a month is enough. In conclusion, I would keep the contest and drop the comparison: let the beginner show what four weeks can do, and stop pretending that it is the same thing.
